newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cofir sees NH deal with Accor soon - paper.
newsitem.headline: Cofir sees NH deal with Accor soon - paper.

text.p: Talks between Spanish hotel company NH and French hotel company Accor may produce an agreement to develop two-star hotels in Spain jointly before the end of the month, Gabriel Burgio, executive director of Cofir, the holding company of NH, said in a newspaper interview on Monday.

"These negotiations are always difficult and have seen highs and lows, but there are strong chances that they will lead to the signing of a definitive accord before the end of the month," Burgio told the newspaper Les Echos.
The newspaper said some of the difficulties were due to guarantees demanded by NH founder Antonio Catalan, who wants to remain head of the hotel activities.
Cofir holds 62 percent of NH while Catalan holds 32 percent.
Accor said last week that the talks were continuing with the aim of developing between 70 and 80 two-star hotels under the Ibis insignia in Spain.
Accor and NH signed a preliminary agreement in November.
